tools.name: search_neural
tools.description: Find which Neural System product solves a problem. Searches the computer vision solutions (camera analytics for safety, counting, retail, logistics, agribusiness, healthcare, mining…) and the Windows apps (file repair, data recovery, backup, photos, email, PDF, phone, disk…). Returns the best matche

tools.name: list_vision_solutions
tools.description: List the computer vision solutions by industry, with status (live, lab, on demand), monthly price per camera and page link.

tools.name: get_vision_solution
tools.description: Details of one computer vision solution: what it detects, use cases, metrics, availability, price and links for demo and contact.

tools.name: quote_vision
tools.description: Price estimate for the computer vision subscription: number of cameras and models per camera. Returns monthly fee, setup and volume discount. The final price is confirmed by the Neural team.

tools.name: list_desktop_apps
tools.description: List the Neural Windows apps with category, short description, availability and starting price.

tools.name: get_desktop_app
tools.description: Details of one Windows app: what it does, plans and prices, FAQ, free download and the link where the user buys it (secure Stripe checkout on the app site).

tools.name: request_contact
tools.description: Send the user's contact request to the Neural System sales team (demo, quote, free test with their own video). ONLY call after the user explicitly agreed to share their name and email with Neural System for this purpose. The user receives a confirmation email.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_neural · Private data: search_neural, get_vision_solution, request_contact · Public sink: search_neural, request_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_neural · Private data: search_neural, get_vision_solution, request_contact · Public sink: search_neural, request_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
